correctness.rationale: Complete facet adjacency enumeration yields six old/old edges plus three new/old edges per selected corner. Sign patterns necessarily split 2/2 or one-outlier; their counts yield each of sixteen coordinates. Cone/antipode areas give p_i=Omega_i/(2pi), with all boundary and depth cases addressed. Reproducible rational projected-hull comparisons and stochastic cone-mass checks corroborate, but do not replace, the analytic proof.
